# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive English-French bilingual dictionary from Cambridge University Press with translations, definitions, and corpus-based usage examples.

Cambridge Dictionary provides authoritative English-French translations powered by multiple lexical resources including the PASSWORD English-French Dictionary, GLOBAL English-French Dictionary, and real-world examples from the Cambridge English Corpus, Europarl Parallel Corpus, and Hansard archive. Each entry includes detailed definitions, grammatical information, and contextual usage examples to support language learners and translators.
